339-574-677-1115.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-1115.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

777-1170-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

301-5805-7860.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
301-5805-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1865-2232-7827-7833.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
1865-2232-7827-7833.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6136-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6136-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6136-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2034-2567-4013.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands.
2034-2567-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Avenger of Zendikar.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2523-2665-2869.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Progenitor Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Progenitor Mimic dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Progenitor Mimic that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Progenitor Mimic token instead.
2523-2665-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

4377-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
4377-7443.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
4377-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
4377-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7415.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

647-3457-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4488-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1661-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1661-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3661-5220-5330-6900.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2173-2438-3652-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2341-3649-5277.notablePrerequisites:
(THE PEREGRINE DYNAMO'S TARGET) is not your commander.
An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-3649-5277.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying The Peregrine Dynamo's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Peregrine Dynamo triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

1640-3901-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Wrathful Red Dragon instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

198-478-6871.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with an indestructible counter on it

4761-5619-6527.easyPrerequisites: You have three or less opponents.
4761-5619-6527.description:
Activate Myojin of Roaring Blades by removing an indestructible counter from it.
Holding priority, cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Resolve the Myojin of Roaring Blades ability, dealing 7 damage to each of up to three opponents.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1977-2097-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1977-2097-4499.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

428-1692-1694-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-1694-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

413-3558-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crookshank Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

586-5147-5626-6112.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1849-3259-4191-5022.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a nontoken creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-4191-5022.description:
Declare Treasury Thrull and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1938-4200-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart until Glorious Protector enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.

2249-4659-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2249-4659-5086.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan ironworks by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
When the Triskelavite dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Triskelavite using its own ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1558-2963-4231-4772-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
